reviews.comment: He provided all the information needed to understand the topics. Homework was long, but doable. Exams were take-home, and the final was in person. Tests were open-everything, except collab. Class was graded on a normalized scale, where having a 75% or above of the top score earned you an A or B. You'll succeed if you try your best on all your work!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class
